items.exampleEn: The players worked together to defend their goal.
items.exampleZh: 球員們齊心協力守住自己的球門。

items.exampleEn: Please ensure that your name is on every page.
items.exampleZh: 請確認每一頁上都有你的名字。

items.exampleEn: The glass slipped out of my hand and broke.
items.exampleZh: 杯子從我手中滑落，摔破了。

items.exampleEn: A combination of rain and wind made the trip hard.
items.exampleZh: 雨加上風，讓這趟旅程很辛苦。

items.exampleEn: We must eliminate all the mistakes before printing.
items.exampleZh: 印之前我們必須消除所有錯誤。

items.exampleEn: She is a friend you can always rely on.
items.exampleZh: 她是個你隨時都可以依賴的朋友。

items.exampleEn: The festival attracts thousands of visitors every year.
items.exampleZh: 這個節慶每年吸引數千名遊客。

items.exampleEn: Stir the soup slowly for two minutes.

items.sentenceEn: Many people rely on their phones to find their way.
items.sentenceZh: 很多人依賴手機來找路。

items.audioEn: I slipped on the stairs this morning, but luckily I was not hurt.
items.audioZh: 我今天早上在樓梯上滑了一跤，還好沒受傷。
items.questionZh: 說話者今天早上發生了什麼事？
options: Fell off a bike on the road

items.sentenceEn: The new rules ensure that everyone gets a fair chance.
items.sentenceZh: 新規定確保每個人都有公平的機會。

items.sentenceEn: Bright colors attract the attention of young children.
items.sentenceZh: 鮮豔的顏色會吸引小孩子的注意。

items.stemEn: Add some sugar and ____ the tea with a spoon.
items.stemZh: 加一點糖，再用湯匙攪拌茶。

items.stemEn: This dish is a great ____ of sweet and sour flavors.
items.stemZh: 這道菜把酸甜兩種味道結合得很好。

items.passageEn: Our town's night market has changed a lot. To attract more young visitors, it added food stands with an interesting combination of Taiwanese and Japanese dishes. The town also wanted to ensure safety, so it eliminated the problem of blocked paths. Some shop owners defended the traditional way, but most agreed to the changes. Today, many families rely on the market for cheap dinners. But be careful: the stone paths are easy to slip on after rain.
items.passageZh: 我們鎮上的夜市改變了很多。為了吸引更多年輕遊客，夜市增加了一些攤位，賣台式和日式料理的有趣組合。鎮公所也想確保安全，所以解決了通道被擋住的問題。有些店家為傳統做法辯護，但大部分都同意改變。現在很多家庭依賴夜市解決便宜的晚餐。不過要小心：雨後石板路很容易滑倒。

questions.questionZh: 夜市為了吸引年輕遊客做了什麼？
options: 延長整個夜市的營業時間
舉辦一場大型音樂表演

questions.questionZh: 文章提醒大家注意什麼？

referenceEn: You can't just rely on other people.
You can't rely only on others.
rubricZh: rely on＋人、事物等，表示「依賴」，on 不可少

items.promptZh: 這位老師總是確保每個學生都聽得懂。
referenceEn: This teacher always ensures that every student understands.
The teacher always ensures every student can understand.
rubricZh: 用 ensure 表示「確保」（that 可省略；寫 make sure 也正確）
「聽得懂」可寫，例如 understands、can understand、can follow 等
